hooks.command: B="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/skill-matcher/sm"; S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src"; N=$(ls -t "$S"/*.cpp "$S"/*.hpp 2>/dev/null | head -1); if ! { [ -x "$B" ] && [ -n "$N" ] && [ ! "$N" -nt "$B" ]; }; then mkdir -p "${B%/*}"; c++ -std=c++20 -O2 -o "$B" "$S"/*.cpp 2>/dev/null || echo "skill-matcher: no working C++ compiler, so no skills will be suggested this session"; fi
